nativeKernelChange: O8 where output width is divisible by16; otherwise O4. Routes dispatched before column tiles. Same Q8 words, scale/bias values, FP32 product and accumulation order, SIMD reduction and BF16 rounding.
compiledPolicyIdentity: Four retained identity objects keyed by unpacking and layout. Compiled MoE fingerprints change when either or both policies change.
researchNotes:
Retained candidate: O=8 (where output width multiple16), SG=2, Rows=2, existing byte unpack, route-first two-dimensional dispatch. Existing FP32 products, group affine sums, SIMD reduction and BF16 output unchanged. O=4 fallback for widths only divisible by8.
Expert screen: O8/SG2 6.65% paired block reduction; route-scheduled screen 9.31% paired block reduction. Bit-identical outputs.
Projection screen: gate/up O8/SG2 2.04% paired reduction; down O8/SG2 13.77%. Separate forced barriers, not additive stage budgets.
Metadata and record layouts: exact but no useful gain; not retained and no format change.
GELU fusion prototype: full block outputs differ (max .015625); rejected. This rejects this prototype, not all possible fusion.
Vocabulary MPP: R16 16x32 bit exact but neutral. R15 all MPP variants differ in68/3,932,160 logits despite same top1s on sampled inputs; rejected for exact parity.
Vocabulary transpose: 125 differing logits at R15; 148 at R16. Not retained.
Vocabulary wider reuse: all same logits, V8 and V15 slower. V5/SIMD4 roughly5% faster in one screen but fused-cap followup neutral; not native-qualified.
Vocabulary capped reuse SG16: 2.81% isolated capped-head reduction. Small, single input screen; not promoted.
Vocabulary tiled greedy: same sampled token IDs, 12–63% slower; rejected.
Compiled softcap: exhaustive all finite BF16 inputs bitwise equal. 11% pointwise reduction (~22us) but .18–.27% full head reduction R15/R16; not promoted.
Local MLX checkout has pre-existing quantized.cpp modification enabling generation17 affineQ8 NAX. Preserved; hash and diff saved. Call that baseline local MLX, not pristine upstream.
limitations: Warm resident measurements exclude model loading, audio I/O and admission queueing. They include feature extraction, encoder/projector, prefill, generation, synchronization and cleanup.
Two fresh processes per clip reverse clip and starting-mode order; bootstrap resamples adjacent pairs within each process.
Other jobs can run on this shared machine; this task ran no build, profiler, file copy or competing benchmark during qualified samples.
The MLX checkout has a pre-existing quantized.cpp patch enabling generation17 affine Q8 NAX; preserved and hashed. The MLX comparison is local dispatch, not a pristine upstream build.
Vocabulary matrix alternatives can preserve top1 on a sample while changing logits; those candidates were rejected. No vocabulary kernel change is shipped in this pass.
No new hardware-counter replay or multilingual WER evaluation was run. Intermediate expert arrays and frozen tokens/acceptance counts are the parity evidence.
microbenchmarkInputScope: Vocabulary shape screens use captured normalized target hidden states, taking the first 15 rows for the draft-shaped screen.
